lines.trans: Good morning, treasure hunters! I brought hot coffee before my bread dough rises.
Perfect timing, Rocio—Mateo is lifting the third stone right now!
Hold the lantern low, Clara, while I prop this stone safely on a wooden block.
Oh, look down inside that neat square pocket of clean dry river sand!
Someone lined the sides with four red bricks to keep the winter rain out!
That sounds like smart old engineering—and look what is resting in the middle.

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: It is a square bundle tied with twine and wrapped in thick yellow waxed cloth!

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: May I reach down and lift it out, Mateo?
Go ahead, Clara, both hands—tell us if it feels wet or heavy.
It is completely dry, surprisingly light, and something metal just slid inside!
Carry it straight into Room Nine before the upstairs windows open for breakfast!
I will set the flat stone back in place so nobody trips over table one.

words.gloss: I will return (volver a = do again)

Perfect timing, Rocio—Mateo is lifting the third stone right now!
Hold the lantern low, Clara, while I prop this stone safely on a wooden block.
Oh, look down inside that neat square pocket of clean dry river sand!

words.gloss: I will return (volver a = do again)

lines.trans: See you later!

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Indicates position or movement downward.

examples.text: La cocina está abajo.
examples.trans: The kitchen is downstairs.

examples.text: Te espero abajo en el patio.
examples.trans: I will wait for you downstairs in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle abierto.

examples.text: Abro la ventana por la mañana.
examples.trans: I open the window in the morning.

examples.text: Ayer abrimos la tienda temprano.
examples.trans: Yesterday we opened the shop early.

acabar.gloss: to finish; to have just (acabar de)

meanings.en: to finish; to have just (acabar de)
meanings.note: Acabar de + infinitive means 'to have just done something'.

examples.text: Acabo de llegar del mercado.
examples.trans: I have just arrived from the market.

examples.text: Ya acabamos el trabajo de hoy.
examples.trans: We already finished today's work.

acercar.gloss: to bring closer; to move closer

meanings.en: to bring closer; to move closer
meanings.note: Spelling changes c -> qu before -e (acerqué, acerque).

examples.text: Acerca la lámpara a la mesa de trabajo, por favor.
examples.trans: Bring the lamp closer to the workbench, please.

examples.text: Acercamos dos sillas de madera junto al piano.
examples.trans: We move two wooden chairs closer to the piano.

meanings.note: Warm invitation to enter a room or proceed.

examples.text: ¡Adelante, la puerta está abierta!
examples.trans: Come in, the door is open!

examples.text: Adelante, puede sentarse aquí.
examples.trans: Go right ahead, you may sit here.

meanings.note: Ahora mismo means 'right now'.

examples.text: Voy para allá ahora mismo.
examples.trans: I am heading there right now.

examples.text: Ahora tenemos cuatro mesas libres.
examples.trans: Now we have four free tables.

meanings.note: Points to something at medium distance or near the listener.

examples.text: Deja las llaves ahí en la mesa.
examples.trans: Leave the keys there on the table.

examples.text: Ahí viene el autobús.
examples.trans: There comes the bus.

meanings.note: Indefinite pronoun used in statements and questions.

examples.text: ¿Necesita algo más de la cocina?
examples.trans: Do you need anything else from the kitchen?

examples.text: Hay algo dentro de la caja.
examples.trans: There is something inside the box.

meanings.note: Refers exclusively to people.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de llamar a la puerta.
examples.trans: Someone just knocked at the door.

examples.text: ¿Hay alguien en recepción?
examples.trans: Is anyone at the front desk?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number with its noun.

examples.text: Es una pieza amarilla.
examples.trans: It is a yellow piece.

examples.text: ¡Acaba de parar un taxi amarillo frente a la verja de hierro!
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.note: Antes de means 'before' a noun or infinitive.

examples.text: Llegué diez minutos antes.
examples.trans: I arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: Antes de salir, cierra la ventana.
examples.trans: Before leaving, close the window.

meanings.note: Placed after a noun, means 'historic' or 'old-fashioned'.

examples.text: Es una pieza antigua.
examples.trans: It is an old piece.

examples.text: Encantada, Tomás, ¡siempre que nadie hable de vender pianos antiguos!
examples.trans: Gladly, Tomas, as long as nobody talks about selling old pianos!

apoyar.gloss: to lean; to rest; to support

meanings.en: to lean; to rest; to support
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb; apoyar algo contra la pared means 'to lean something against the wall'.

examples.text: Apoya la escalera con cuidado contra el ladrillo.
examples.trans: Lean the ladder carefully against the brick.

examples.text: Apoyamos las sillas dobladas debajo del arco.
examples.trans: We lean the folded chairs under the arch.

meanings.note: False friend reminder: la arena means 'sand' (as on a beach or riverbed), though it also gave English 'arena' via the sand-strewn floor of Roman amphitheatres.

examples.text: El hueco bajo la piedra estaba lleno de arena seca.
examples.trans: The cavity under the stone was full of dry sand.

examples.text: Caminamos descalzos por la arena tibia de la playa.
examples.trans: We walked barefoot along the warm sand of the beach.

meanings.note: Opposite of abajo.

examples.text: Las habitaciones están arriba.
examples.trans: The bedrooms are upstairs.

examples.text: Mira arriba hacia el balcón.
examples.trans: Look up toward the balcony.

meanings.note: Past-participle adjective from atar (to tie).

examples.text: Es una pieza atada.
examples.trans: It is a tied piece.

examples.text: Hay una pequeña tarjeta de cartón atada al asa.
examples.trans: There is a small cardboard card tied to the handle.

meanings.note: Used for a solid block of wood or stone (un bloque de madera), a notepad, or an apartment building (un bloque de pisos).

examples.text: Apoyó la losa pesada sobre un bloque de madera.
examples.trans: He propped the heavy flagstone on a wooden block.

examples.text: Vivimos en el tercer bloque de la calle.
examples.trans: We live in the third building on the street.

meanings.note: Shortens to buen before masculine singular nouns (buen viaje); ¡Buenos días! = Good morning!

examples.text: ¡Buenos días a todos!
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone!

examples.text: Hace muy buen tiempo hoy.
examples.trans: The weather is very nice today.

meanings.note: Agent noun from buscar ('to look for'); buscador de tesoros means 'treasure hunter'.

examples.text: ¡Buenos días a los mejores buscadores de tesoros del barrio!
examples.trans: Good morning to the best treasure hunters in the neighbourhood!

examples.text: Escribí el nombre de la calle en el buscador.
examples.trans: I typed the street name into the search engine.

meanings.note: Plural los cafés (two coffees = dos cafés).

examples.text: El café está aquí.
examples.trans: The coffee is here.

examples.text: Vemos los cafés desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the coffees from the door.

meanings.note: Describes hot drinks, food, or water.

examples.text: Es una pieza caliente.
examples.trans: It is a hot piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene, señora: té caliente de menta con miel.
examples.trans: Here you are, madam: hot mint tea with honey.

meanings.note: El centro is downtown.

examples.text: El centro está aquí.
examples.trans: The city centre is here.

examples.text: Vemos los centros desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the city centres from the door.

meanings.note: Covers beeswax (cera de abejas), candle wax, and sealing wax on letters (un sello de cera roja).

examples.text: El sobre antiguo lleva un sello de cera roja.
examples.trans: The old envelope bears a red wax seal.

examples.text: La tela con cera protege el paquete de la lluvia.
examples.trans: The waxed cloth protects the parcel from the rain.

colocar.gloss: to place; to set out; to fit in place

meanings.en: to place; to set out; to fit in place
meanings.note: Spelling changes c -> qu before -e (coloqué).

examples.text: Colocamos cuatro sillas alrededor de cada mesa redonda.
examples.trans: We set out four chairs around each round table.

examples.text: Coloca el pasador con cuidado usando las pinzas.
examples.trans: Fit the pin carefully using the tweezers.

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

meanings.note: Also used as a masculine noun (el cuadrado, 'the square') and in metros cuadrados ('square metres').

examples.text: Sacaron un paquete cuadrado envuelto en lino.
examples.trans: They lifted out a square bundle wrapped in linen.

examples.text: En la lata había cuatro tarjetas cuadradas de papel.
examples.trans: In the tin there were four square paper cards.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Tenemos cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: We have four tables inside.

examples.text: La habitación cuatro da al patio.
examples.trans: Room four looks out onto the courtyard.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb in present and preterite, but has the irregular past participle cubierto ('covered').

examples.text: Alguien cubrió los lados del hueco con ladrillos rojos.
examples.trans: Someone lined the sides of the cavity with red bricks.

examples.text: Rocío cubre la masa con un paño limpio.
examples.trans: Rocío covers the dough with a clean cloth.

meanings.note: Used for piano or guitar strings as well as rope.

examples.text: El macillo golpea tres cuerdas de acero a la vez.
examples.trans: The hammer strikes three steel strings at once.

examples.text: Esa cuerda central suena clara después de afinarla.
examples.trans: That middle string sounds clear after tuning it.

meanings.note: Con cuidado = carefully; ¡Cuidado con...! = Mind the...!

examples.text: El cuidado es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The care is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el cuidado.
examples.trans: We talk about the care.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Querer decir means 'to mean'.

examples.text: ¿Qué dice la carta exactamente?
examples.trans: What does the letter say exactly?

examples.text: Dime la verdad sin miedo.
examples.trans: Tell me the truth without fear.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

meanings.note: Dentro de + time means 'in (after) a certain amount of time'.

examples.text: Hay cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: There are four tables inside.

examples.text: Vuelvo dentro de diez minutos.
examples.trans: I will be back in ten minutes.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Descanso media hora después de comer.
examples.trans: I rest half an hour after lunch.

examples.text: Los huéspedes descansaron muy bien.
examples.trans: The guests rested very well.

meanings.note: Also used adverbially (salir directo = walk straight out).

examples.text: Es una pieza directa.
examples.trans: It is a direct piece.

examples.text: Sí, Rocío. Aunque dé media vuelta y salga directo por la puerta.
examples.trans: Yes, Rocio. Even if he turns around and walks straight back out the gate.

meanings.note: Los dos / las dos means 'both'.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas azules en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two blue cups on the table.

examples.text: Compra las dos válvulas por favor.
examples.trans: Buy both valves, please.

meanings.note: Masculine despite ending in -a: el día, ¡Buenos días!.

examples.text: El día está aquí.
examples.trans: The day is here.

examples.text: Vemos los días desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the days from the door.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

entrar.gloss: to come in; to go in; to enter

meanings.en: to come in; to go in; to enter
meanings.note: Pairs with en in Spain (entrar en la posada).

examples.text: Entra mucha luz por el balcón.
examples.trans: Plenty of light comes in through the balcony.

examples.text: Entramos en la tienda para resguardarnos.
examples.trans: We stepped into the shop to shelter.

meanings.note: Past-participle adjective from envolver.

examples.text: Es una pieza envuelta.
examples.trans: It is a wrapped piece.

examples.text: ¿Y qué es esto envuelto en papel blanco? ¡Un trenecito de madera!
examples.trans: And what is this wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Forms: ese, esa, esos, esas.

examples.text: Pásame ese cuaderno azul.
examples.trans: Pass me that blue notebook.

examples.text: Esa maleta pertenece a un cliente.
examples.trans: That suitcase belongs to a guest.

meanings.note: Neuter pronoun; por eso = that is why.

examples.text: Por eso traje dos paraguas.
examples.trans: That is why I brought two umbrellas.

examples.text: ¿Qué significa eso exactamente?
examples.trans: What does that mean exactly?

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: Forms: este (m sg), esta (f sg), estos (m pl), estas (f pl).

examples.text: Este patio es muy tranquilo.
examples.trans: This courtyard is very quiet.

examples.text: Esta mañana hace mucho sol.
examples.trans: This morning it is very sunny.

meanings.note: Plural faroles; classic wrought-iron courtyard lantern.

examples.text: Encendemos los faroles del patio al caer la tarde.
examples.trans: We light the courtyard lanterns at dusk.

examples.text: El farol de hierro alumbra toda la escalera.
examples.trans: The iron lantern lights up the whole staircase.

meanings.note: Plural habitaciones.

examples.text: La habitación está aquí.
examples.trans: The room is here.

examples.text: Vemos las habitaciones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rooms from the door.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! = See you later!; ¡Hasta mañana! = See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Sigue recto hasta el puente.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead as far as the bridge.

examples.text: Nos quedamos hasta el viernes.
examples.trans: We are staying until Friday.

meanings.note: Sonar hueco means 'to sound hollow' when tapped; as a noun (el hueco), it means 'gap, space, or free slot'.

examples.text: Ese tronco viejo está hueco por dentro.
examples.trans: That old tree trunk is hollow inside.

examples.text: Al pisar la tercera piedra del patio, sonó hueca.
examples.trans: When stepping on the third courtyard stone, it sounded hollow.

meanings.note: Proparoxytone (esdrújula), so it always keeps its written accent.

examples.text: El aire húmedo del mar entra por el balcón.
examples.trans: Damp sea air comes in through the balcony.

examples.text: Pasa primero un paño húmedo sobre la pizarra.
examples.trans: Run a damp cloth across the board first.

meanings.note: Justo aquí = right here; justo al lado = right next door.

examples.text: La llave está justo aquí.
examples.trans: The key is right here.

examples.text: La panadería queda justo al lado.
examples.trans: The bakery is right next door.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Al lado = on the side / next door.

examples.text: El lado está aquí.
examples.trans: The side is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lados desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the sides from the door.

meanings.note: De ladrillo = made of brick.

examples.text: El ladrillo está aquí.
examples.trans: The brick is here.

examples.text: Vemos los ladrillos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the bricks from the door.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

levantar.gloss: to lift; to raise; to get up (levantarse)

meanings.en: to lift; to raise; to get up (levantarse)
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Levanta esa esquina de la alfombra.
examples.trans: Lift that corner of the rug.

examples.text: Nos levantamos a las seis y media.
examples.trans: We get up at six thirty.

meanings.note: Opposite of sucio (dirty).

examples.text: Es una pieza limpia.
examples.trans: It is a clean piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene un paño limpio y agua fría, Ernesto.
examples.trans: Here is a clean cloth and cold water, Ernesto.

meanings.note: Opposite of vacío (empty).

examples.text: Es una pieza llena.
examples.trans: It is a full piece.

examples.text: Vaya... ¿con esta lluvia? Todos los hoteles cerca de la estación parecían llenos.
examples.trans: Oh dear... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.

llevar.gloss: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)

meanings.en: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)
meanings.note: Versatile verb for carrying items, wearing clothes/glasses, or duration.

examples.text: Llevo dos tazas calientes al jardín.
examples.trans: I carry two hot cups to the garden.

examples.text: Hoy lleva un abrigo gris oscuro.
examples.trans: Today he is wearing a dark grey coat.

meanings.note: Bajo la lluvia = in the rain.

examples.text: La lluvia es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The rain is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la lluvia.
examples.trans: We talk about the rain.

lo.gloss: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)

meanings.en: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)
meanings.note: Direct object pronoun before verbs (lo veo), and neuter article in lo que ('what') or lo mejor ('the best').

examples.text: Ya lo veo encima del estante.
examples.trans: I see it now on the shelf.

examples.text: Lo mejor del patio es la calma.
examples.trans: The best part of the courtyard is the calm.

meanings.note: Los viernes means 'every Friday / on Fridays'.

examples.text: Los vecinos vienen a desayunar.
examples.trans: The neighbours come for breakfast.

examples.text: Daba clases de piano los viernes.
examples.trans: She taught piano lessons on Fridays.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! is Spain's most common everyday farewell.

examples.text: Cruza el puente y luego gira.
examples.trans: Cross the bridge and then turn.

examples.text: ¡Hasta luego, que tengas buen día!
examples.trans: See you later, have a good day!

meanings.note: De madera = wooden.

examples.text: La madera está aquí.
examples.trans: The wood is here.

examples.text: Vemos las maderas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the woods from the door.

meanings.note: Feminine despite ending in -o: la mano, las manos; a mano derecha = on your right-hand side.

examples.text: Gira después de la farmacia a mano derecha.
examples.trans: Turn past the pharmacy on your right-hand side.

examples.text: Tengo las manos limpias.
examples.trans: My hands are clean.

meanings.note: Bread or pastry dough.

examples.text: La masa es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The dough is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la masa.
examples.trans: We talk about the dough.

meanings.note: With de, algo de metal or una caja de metal describes something made of metal.

examples.text: Algo de metal acaba de moverse dentro del paquete.
examples.trans: Something metal just moved inside the parcel.

examples.text: Limpiamos el tirador de metal de la puerta principal.
examples.trans: We polished the metal handle on the front door.

meter.gloss: to put in; to tuck in

meanings.en: to put in; to tuck in
meanings.note: Everyday Spanish verb specifically for putting something inside a pocket, bag, or drawer.

examples.text: Meto las llaves en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: I put the keys in my pocket.

examples.text: Metimos las sillas dentro por la lluvia.
examples.trans: We brought the chairs inside because of the rain.

meanings.note: Links two simultaneous actions.

examples.text: Espera aquí mientras abro la puerta.
examples.trans: Wait here while I open the door.

examples.text: Preparo el té mientras sale el pan.
examples.trans: I make the tea while the bread comes out.

mirar.gloss: to look; to look at; to watch

meanings.en: to look; to look at; to watch
meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'at' (mira el reloj = look at the clock).

examples.text: Mira qué sol hace esta mañana.
examples.trans: Look how sunny it is this morning.

examples.text: Miramos el mapa antes de salir.
examples.trans: We look at the map before going out.

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun it describes.
In ahora mismo, meaning right now, mismo strengthens the time word ahora. Now comes from ahora; mismo supplies emphasis without agreeing with a person in this expression.

examples.text: Tenemos el mismo trabajo.
examples.trans: We have the same job.

examples.text: Ahora mismo estoy ocupada.
examples.trans: I am busy right now.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: muevo).

examples.text: Movemos la mesa bajo la sombra.
examples.trans: We move the table into the shade.

examples.text: El viento suave movió las hojas.
examples.trans: The gentle breeze stirred the leaves.

meanings.note: Shortened form of mucho used before adjectives and adverbs.

examples.text: El bizcocho está muy rico.
examples.trans: The sponge cake is very tasty.

examples.text: Camina muy rápido por el puente.
examples.trans: She walks very fast across the bridge.

meanings.note: Requires no before the verb when nadie follows (no hay nadie).

examples.text: Todavía no hay nadie en el patio.
examples.trans: There is nobody in the courtyard yet.

examples.text: Nadie conoce mejor este edificio.
examples.trans: Nobody knows this building better.

meanings.note: Placed directly before the verb (or object pronouns) to negate a sentence.

examples.text: Hoy no llueve en Valencia.
examples.trans: Today it is not raining in Valencia.

examples.text: No se preocupe por la hora.
examples.trans: Do not worry about the time.

meanings.note: Covers jotted notes, musical notes, and review scores.

examples.text: La nota está aquí.
examples.trans: The note is here.

examples.text: Vemos las notas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the notes from the door.

meanings.note: Las nueve = nine o'clock.

examples.text: El tren llega a las nueve en punto.
examples.trans: The train arrives at nine on the dot.

examples.text: Vimos un nueve sobre diez.
examples.trans: We saw a nine out of ten.

meanings.note: Becomes u before words starting with o- or ho-.

examples.text: ¿Prefieres café o té caliente?
examples.trans: Do you prefer coffee or hot tea?

examples.text: ¿Abrimos hoy o esperamos a mañana?
examples.trans: Do we open today or wait until tomorrow?

meanings.note: Skilled craft or trade learned through practice.

examples.text: El oficio está aquí.
examples.trans: The trade is here.

examples.text: Vemos los oficios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the trades from the door.

meanings.note: Expresses surprise or realization.

examples.text: ¡Oh, ahí está la puerta azul!
examples.trans: Oh, there is the blue door!

examples.text: Oh, perdona, no te había visto.
examples.trans: Oh, sorry, I had not seen you.

meanings.note: Plural los panes; pan recién hecho = freshly baked bread.

examples.text: El pan es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The bread is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el pan.
examples.trans: We talk about the bread.

meanings.note: Wrapped package or parcel.

examples.text: El paquete está aquí.
examples.trans: The parcel is here.

examples.text: Vemos los paquetes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the parcels from the door.

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Describes a heavy suitcase, wrench, or coat.

examples.text: Es una pieza pesada.
examples.trans: It is a heavy piece.

examples.text: Cerrada y vaciada. Pásame la llave inglesa pesada de tu izquierda.
examples.trans: Off and drained. Pass me the heavy wrench on your left.

pesar.gloss: to weigh (pesar mucho = to be very heavy)

meanings.en: to weigh (pesar mucho = to be very heavy)
meanings.note: Spanish says pesa mucho ('it weighs a lot') for 'it is heavy'.

examples.text: Esta caja de madera pesa bastante.
examples.trans: This wooden box is fairly heavy.

examples.text: El paquete pequeño apenas pesaba nada.
examples.trans: The small parcel weighed almost nothing.

meanings.note: De piedra = made of stone.

examples.text: La piedra está aquí.
examples.trans: The stone is here.

examples.text: Vemos las piedras desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the stones from the door.

meanings.note: Architectural drawing or city street map.

examples.text: El plano está aquí.
examples.trans: The blueprint is here.

examples.text: Vemos los planos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the blueprints from the door.

meanings.note: Un poco de mantequilla = a little butter.

examples.text: ¿Quiere un poco de miel en el té?
examples.trans: Would you like a little honey in your tea?

examples.text: Quedan pocos minutos para el mediodía.
examples.trans: Few minutes remain until noon.

poder.gloss: can; to be able to; may

meanings.en: can; to be able to; may
meanings.note: Irregular: puedo, pude, podría.

examples.text: ¿Puedo ver la etiqueta otra vez?
examples.trans: May I look at the tag again?

examples.text: Hoy podemos desayunar en el patio.
examples.trans: Today we can have breakfast in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number.

examples.text: Es una pieza roja.
examples.trans: It is a red piece.

examples.text: ¡Dígales que la mía tiene una cinta roja en el bolsillo de arriba!
examples.trans: Tell them mine has a red ribbon in the top pocket!

sacar.gloss: to take out; to pull out

meanings.en: to take out; to pull out
meanings.note: Spelling changes c -> qu before -e (saqué).

examples.text: Rocío acaba de sacar el pan caliente del horno.
examples.trans: Rocio just took the hot bread out of the oven.

examples.text: Saca las llaves pequeñas del bolsillo del abrigo.
examples.trans: Take the small keys out of your coat pocket.

se.gloss: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one

meanings.en: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one
meanings.note: Reflexive, reciprocal, passive/impersonal pronoun, and indirect object le/les before lo/la.

examples.text: La puerta se abre despacio.
examples.trans: The door opens slowly.

examples.text: Aquí se oye el canto de los pájaros.
examples.trans: Here you can hear the birds singing.

secar.gloss: to dry; to wipe dry (secarse = to dry out)

meanings.en: to dry; to wipe dry (secarse = to dry out)
meanings.note: Spelling changes c -> qu before -e (sequé, seque).

examples.text: Seca bien las bisagras antes de dar la pintura.
examples.trans: Dry the hinges thoroughly before applying paint.

examples.text: Con este sol la ropa tendida se seca enseguida.
examples.trans: In this sunshine the hanging laundry dries right away.

meanings.note: Toallas secas = dry towels.

examples.text: Es una pieza seca.
examples.trans: It is a dry piece.

examples.text: ¡Javier lo dejó ahí cuando cogió la toalla seca!
examples.trans: Javier set it down there when he took the dry towel!

ser.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

meanings.en: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)
meanings.note: Used for names, professions, ownership (es mía), materials (es de madera), and clock time.

examples.text: Soy arquitecta y vivo en Valencia.
examples.trans: I am an architect and live in Valencia.

examples.text: Esa maleta azul es mía.
examples.trans: That blue suitcase is mine.

meanings.note: Unaccented conjunction, distinct from accented sí ('yes').

examples.text: Avísame si necesitas otra manta.
examples.trans: Let me know if you need another blanket.

examples.text: Mira si queda leche en la nevera.
examples.trans: Check whether any milk is left in the fridge.

meanings.note: Everyday Peninsula favourite for 'place' or 'seat'.

examples.text: El sitio está aquí.
examples.trans: The place is here.

examples.text: Vemos los sitios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the place from the door.

sobre.gloss: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)

meanings.en: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)
meanings.note: Sobre todo = above all / mostly; also a homograph noun el sobre ('envelope').

examples.text: Deja la llave sobre el mostrador.
examples.trans: Leave the key on the counter.

examples.text: Sacó nueve sobre diez en la prueba.
examples.trans: She scored nine out of ten on the test.

su.gloss: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)

meanings.en: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)
meanings.note: Plural sus (su maleta / sus maletas).

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave, señora.
examples.trans: Here is your key, madam.

examples.text: Sus habitaciones están en la primera planta.
examples.trans: Your rooms are on the first floor.

subir.gloss: to go up; to climb; to carry upstairs

meanings.en: to go up; to climb; to carry upstairs
meanings.note: Works both intransitively and transitively.

examples.text: Subo las toallas limpias a la primera planta.
examples.trans: I carry the clean towels up to the first floor.

examples.text: Subieron despacio la escalera de madera.
examples.trans: They climbed the wooden stairs slowly.

meanings.note: Material for clothes, curtains or old cable covers.

examples.text: Esta camisa es de una tela muy suave.
examples.trans: This shirt is made of a very soft fabric.

examples.text: Compro tela para las cortinas.
examples.trans: I'm buying fabric for the curtains.

meanings.note: Shortens to tercer before masculine singular nouns (el tercer escalón).

examples.text: Es una pieza tercera.
examples.trans: It is a third piece.

examples.text: ¡Vamos, carrera hasta la tercera planta!
examples.trans: Come on, race you to the third floor!

meanings.note: Appears in un mapa del tesoro ('a treasure map') and buscadores de tesoros ('treasure hunters').

examples.text: Ernesto dijo que habéis sacado un tesoro bajo las piedras.
examples.trans: Ernesto said that you dug up a treasure under the stones.

examples.text: La receta partida parece un auténtico mapa del tesoro.
examples.trans: The split recipe looks like a real treasure map.

meanings.note: ¿Qué tiempo hace? asks about the weather; a tiempo = on time.

examples.text: El tiempo está aquí.
examples.trans: The time is here.

examples.text: Vemos los tiempos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the times from the door.

examples.text: La carpeta está llena totalmente.
examples.trans: The folder is completely full.

examples.text: Estoy totalmente de acuerdo.
examples.trans: I completely agree.

meanings.note: Irregular: traigo, traje; future traeré.

examples.text: Ahora mismo le traigo una cuchara.
examples.trans: I will bring you a spoon right now.

examples.text: Ayer trajo flores del mercado.
examples.trans: Yesterday she brought flowers from the market.

meanings.note: Stem-changing e → ie verb (tropiezo, tropiece) with z → c before -e; takes con before the obstacle (tropezar con una piedra).

examples.text: Volveré a colocar la piedra plana para que nadie tropiece.
examples.trans: I will put the flat stone back in place so nobody trips.

examples.text: Casi tropiezo con el escalón de la entrada.
examples.trans: I almost tripped over the front step.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Una ventana soleada = a sunny window.

examples.text: La ventana está aquí.
examples.trans: The window is here.

examples.text: Vemos las ventanas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the windows from the door.

volver.gloss: to return; to come back; to do again (volver a + inf)

meanings.en: to return; to come back; to do again (volver a + inf)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: vuelvo), past participle vuelto; volverse + adj = become.

examples.text: Vuelvo en cinco minutos.
examples.trans: I will be back in five minutes.

examples.text: Volvió a sonreír enseguida.
examples.trans: He smiled again right away.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.

meanings.note: Often omitted in Spanish unless adding contrast or emphasis.

examples.text: Yo abro la puerta y tú llevas la linterna.
examples.trans: I will open the door and you carry the flashlight.

examples.text: Soy yo, abre por favor.
examples.trans: It is me, please open up.
